module.purpose: Manages change subscriptions and event emission for collection data, handling subscriber lifecycle, event batching, and coordination with sync/state/lifecycle managers.
module.summary: The CollectionChangesManager class coordinates change event handling for database collections. It tracks active subscribers, batches events for performance, enriches change messages with virtual properties, and integrates with the collection's lifecycle, sync, events, and state managers. The manager starts/stops synchronization based on subscriber activity and provides methods to emit events, subscribe to changes, and clean up resources.
module.businessContext: Enables reactive data subscription patterns in the database client. If this fails, applications cannot receive real-time updates from collections, breaking UI reactivity and data synchronization features.
